validity_envelope_text: This report is not a replacement for real user research. It contains no willingness-to-pay estimates. It contains no population percentage extrapolations. It makes no ISO 9241-11 compliance claim. 2 of 3 personas did not complete: willing-to-pay-user, vp-team-buyer.
narrative: CR6-B1 negative control (the 0-crashed/timed-out boundary case the panel named): 1 completed + 2 runner-capped = 3 personas in the F49 not-blocked floor set {completed, patience-exhausted, runner-capped}, so count=3 is NOT < 3 and run_status is NOT BLOCKED. Proves runner-capped (a designed force-abort delivering a valid partial ledger, F57/F176) counts TOWARD the floor, exactly like patience-exhausted, and never pushes toward BLOCKED. The validity envelope still discloses the 2 non-completed personas (F54).
